label: configurator • an impossible cron expression is refused, not silently saved
query: Schedule my Daily Digest workflow with the cron expression 61 8 * * *.
notes: Minute 61 does not exist. The cron is validated before apply, so the plan or apply fails with the five-field explanation; the model must report that (or ask which minute was meant) and must not save an automation that would never fire, nor invent a different time.

seedInstalledWorkflows.name: Daily Digest
seedInstalledWorkflows.summary: Summarize the day's news and calendar.

rubric: Tells the user the cron expression is invalid (minute 61 is out of range, minutes are 0-59) or asks which time they meant, and does not claim the automation was created.
